previous_statement: For the real coefficient field R in the root contract, the given orientation makes M R-orientable (equivalently, an ordinary orientation supplies a real orientation).
new_statement: An ordinary orientation is a locally consistent choice of generators mu_x of the integral local homology groups H_d(M,M\{x};Z) ≅ Z. Under the coefficient inclusion Z -> R, each mu_x maps to mu_x tensor 1, a generator of H_d(M,M\{x};R) ≅ R; naturality of coefficient change preserves the local consistency relations. Hence the given orientation makes M R-orientable for the real coefficient field R.
